name: wheel-bonus-center
about: How the Wheel of Fortune (crmbwanabet/wheel-of-fortune) and the BwanaBet Bonus Center (crmbwanabet/gamification-platform) talk to each other. This file is copied BYTE FOR BYTE in both repos at docs/integrations/wheel-bonus-center-contract.json. Change it in both in the same sitting, bump version, and run the contract tests + `npm run contract:check` in each repo.

wheelToHost.meaning: wheel mounted, send me the token
player closed the wheel / claimed the result

hostToWheel.meaning: the bwanabet `token` JWT, posted ONLY to the wheel origin, never in a URL

launcher.about: ONE widget on bwanabet.com for both apps (owner 2026-10-22): the Bonus Center's widget.js launcher shows the WHEEL icon (the wheel's gift box) while today's spin is open and opens the wheel first; from the spin on it shows the Bonus Center icon (gold K coin) and opens the Bonus Center. Messages between the Bonus Center app and its own widget.js (the wheel itself is not involved).

appToWidget.meaning: today's spin is open (true) or used / unknown / logged out (false); sent when the wheel answers and again at the spin

widgetToApp.meaning: the player tapped the wheel icon: open the wheel on top of the Bonus Center

urlParams.name: test
urlParams.meaning: public TEST mode: no login, simulated spins that never pay (Bonus Center /preview.html)

urlParams.name: closeAfter
urlParams.meaning: with test=1: close after the result like real mode

rules: The wheel stays its own app: prizes, odds, daily limit, kill switch and Telegram payouts live ONLY in the wheel repo and its CRM database.

Both apps moved to bwanabet.dev on 2026-10-22 (MTN blocks vercel.app). The old vercel.app addresses still serve the same deployments: keep 100xbet-gamification.vercel.app in wheelAllowsAuthFrom until every embed loads widget.js from bonus.bwanabet.dev.
The Bonus Center hosts the wheel in an iframe (components/extras/useWheel.jsx) and must accept messages only from origins.wheel and only from its own iframe.
A new Bonus Center domain must be added to the wheel's ALLOWED_AUTH_ORIGINS AND to wheelAllowsAuthFrom here before it goes live, or the wheel never gets the token.

bwanabet.co.zm / bwanabet.com load https://wheel-of-fortune-roan.vercel.app/embed.js (the operator's existing tag). Since v5 that file is a LOADER: it loads https://bonus.bwanabet.dev/widget.js (the one widget, wheel inside) and, only for promo arrivals (?wof=new|existing), /embed-standalone.js with window.__bwArrivalOnly = true so just the arrival popup runs. The standalone wheel embed lives on unchanged as /embed-standalone.js (rollback = copy it back to /embed.js; 5-minute cache).
Never load the standalone wheel button AND the Bonus Center widget on the same page (two wheels).
